title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with Crédit Agricole S.A. and
summary: The Federal Reserve Board announced termination of three Cease and Desist Orders originally issued between 2015 and 2018 against Crédit Agricole S.A., Mega International Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., and The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. All three enforcement actions were terminated on March 25, 2026.
key_points: Credit Agricole S.A. and Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank: Cease and Desist Order dated October 19, 2015, terminated March 25, 2026
Mega International Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (with New York, Chicago, and Silicon Valley branches): Cease and Desist Order dated January 17, 2018, terminated March 25, 2026
The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.: Cease and Desist Order dated May 1, 2018, terminated March 25, 2026
All three enforcement actions terminated on the same date: March 25, 2026
The source provides no explanation for why these specific orders were terminated or what compliance issues were resolved
